answer_1.quote: We propose EdiText, an embedding diffusion-based text editor that supports both coarse‑and fine‑grained editing... We evaluate EdiText's effectiveness by comparing to baselines across four tasks: toxicity control and sentiment control.
answer_1.outputs: Edited text (coarse‑level, fine‑level, or integrated edits)

answer_2.quote: We calculate the following metrics ... Hamming Distance, SacreBLEU, BERTScore, toxicity classifiers (Moderation API, Perspective API), and sentiment classification accuracy.

answer_4.quote: We conduct a human evaluation of EdiText and several baseline models on the task of modifying Enron data to a negative sentiment using Amazon Mechanical Turk. Each participant was asked to rate how well the semantic content of the reference text was preserved in each output using a 5‑point Mean Opinion Score (MOS).
answer_4.guideline: Rate semantic preservation of the reference text on a 5‑point MOS scale.
